# 7401 - Quadruple 2-input NAND gate with open collector output

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7401.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7401.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 4 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7401 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7401.png) | ![7401 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand-oc2.png) | ![7401 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand-oc2.png) |

The NAND rectangle with one vertical line down the centre of the box, dividing it into two halves.

How to tell it on a drawing: Centre vertical bar = open collector. Without the bar it is the plain NAND (7400).

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1Y = NOT(1A AND 1B) | 1Y is the NAND of 1A, 1B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT(2A AND 2B) | 2Y is the NAND of 2A, 2B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 10 | 3Y = NOT(3A AND 3B) | 3Y is the NAND of 3A, 3B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 13 | 4Y = NOT(4A AND 4B) | 4Y is the NAND of 4A, 4B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 5.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Open collector: no IOH figure applies; the datasheet gives an off-state leakage of max 0.25 mA at VOH 5.5 V instead. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 35 | 55 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 4 kohm, CL 15 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. Pinout differs from 7400/7403: outputs on pins 1, 4, 10, 13. tPLH max read from a poor scan as 55 ns.

## Sources

- [TI SN5401/SN54LS01/SN7401/SN74LS01 datasheet SDLS026](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn5401.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7401
